name: You Are My Home
source:
Lockon, Allelujah, and Thielia live in the same orphanage while maintaining delicate relationship. Suddenly a ruthless runaway boy Setsuna joins their company. New story of four people life begins here. Part-time work, house chores, and love, of course, await them!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-november-2008-shikkoku-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
洛克昂、阿雷路亞與提耶利亞住在同一所孤兒院，彼此維持著微妙的關係。突然，冷酷的離家出走少年剎那加入了他們。四個人共同生活的新故事，就此展開。兼職、家務，以及當然少不了的愛情，都在等著他們！

［摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/09/vn-of-month-november-2008-shikkoku-no.html]vndbreview[/url]］
